title: Accenture Technology Vision 2015: Digital Business Era: Stretch Your Boundaries
notes: Five trends, numbered 01-05. Published date from PDF creation date (2015-02-10). Quotes are the one-sentence trend summaries in the Introduction. First edition with a global executive survey (the 2016 report says 'For the second year, we conducted a global survey').

entries.label: The Internet of Me
entries.quote: The Internet of Me is changing the way people around the world interact through technology, placing the end user at the center of every digital experience.
entries.subject: Personalized digital experiences
entries.note: Edition-level horizon: the foreword calls the report 'our annual view of the technology trends that will have a profound impact on enterprises for the next three to five years.' Survey in chapter: 72 percent of executives expect broad adoption of industry platforms that integrate data with digital business partners within the next two years.

entries.label: Outcome Economy
entries.quote: At the same time, digital devices on the edge are powering an Outcome Economy and enabling a new business model that shifts the focus from selling things to selling results.
entries.subject: Outcome-based business models and IoT
entries.note: Edition-level horizon: the foreword calls the report 'our annual view of the technology trends that will have a profound impact on enterprises for the next three to five years.'

entries.label: Platform (R)evolution
entries.quote: The Platform (R)evolution reflects how digital platforms are becoming the tools of choice for building next-generation products and services—and entire ecosystems in the digital and physical worlds.
entries.subject: Digital industry platforms
entries.metric: executives expecting partner APIs to be broadly adopted across their industries
entries.note: Edition-level horizon: the foreword calls the report 'our annual view of the technology trends that will have a profound impact on enterprises for the next three to five years.' Survey line: 'Seventy-one percent expect partner APIs to be broadly adopted across their industries within the next two years.'

entries.label: The Intelligent Enterprise
entries.quote: The Intelligent Enterprise is making its machines smarter—embedding software intelligence into every aspect of its business to drive new levels of operational efficiency, evolution, and innovation.
entries.subject: Enterprise software intelligence and data-driven operations
entries.note: Edition-level horizon: the foreword calls the report 'our annual view of the technology trends that will have a profound impact on enterprises for the next three to five years.'

entries.label: Workforce Reimagined
entries.quote: According to 77 percent of the executives we surveyed, within three years, companies will need to focus on training their machines as much as they do on training their people
entries.subject: Human-machine collaboration in the workforce
entries.metric: executives who say companies will need to focus on training machines as much as people
entries.note: Introduction summary: 'Advances in more natural human interfaces, wearable devices, and smart machines are extending intelligent technology to interact as a “team member,” working alongside employees in a Workforce Reimagined.'
